memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Evidence: Random plasma glucose 182 mg/dL, HbA1c 7.8%.
Symptoms and examination: She reports mild polyuria and fatigue; no respiratory complaints. BMI 24 kg/m2, blood pressure 118/72 mmHg, lungs clear, no wheeze.
Spirometry: FEV1 3.10 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.80 L (95% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.82; change from baseline +0.05 L.
Asthma Control Test not applicable (no asthma).
Inhaler technique: No inhaler prescribed.
Smoking status: Never smoked; pack-years 0.
Plan: Start metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD. Review in 3 months.
